The '''StarSlasher Blaster Carbine''' was a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]].<ref name="HSCS" /> It was one of the oldest working models of blaster carbine in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and was very reliable, able to remain functional after being left neglected in a storage crate for a decade.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

[[Abin-Ral-Xufush]] possessed a StarSlasher blaster carbine,<ref name="P&P">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> as did the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorsk]].<ref name="GFT" />
